title: Wage Offsets and Other Support to Encourage Hiring of Chronically Ill Persons
what_it_is: Wage Offsets and Other Support to Encourage Hiring of Chronically Ill Persons

sections.label: Support for chronically ill workers
sections.summary: The Minister was asked whether wage offsets or other support will be extended to encourage hiring chronically ill persons such as kidney dialysis patients.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Terence Ho
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider extending wage offsets or other forms of support to encourage the hiring of chronically ill persons, such as kidney dialysis patients, who may not meet the prevailing definition of persons with disability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Those who require time for treatment, such as kidney dialysis patients, may request for flexible work schedules to accommodate their treatment regime.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangement (FWA) Requests support such requests.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Others might need workplace adjustments or modified duties to ease physical strain and workloads, which employers would need to work out on a case-by-case basis.

sections.label: Broader employment support services
sections.summary: Individuals can tap on employment support including job matching and career advisory services from Workforce Singapore and the Employment and Employability Institute.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister of Manpower)
sentences.text: Beyond support for FWAs, individuals can tap on a broader suite of employment support, including job matching and career advisory services provided by Workforce Singapore and the National Trades Union Congress' Employment and Employability Institute.

sections.label: Enabling Employment Credit and inclusive hiring
sections.summary: The Enabling Employment Credit is mainly for people with more permanent disabilities, and tripartite partners are working to raise employer awareness on inclusive hiring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: First, to better understand, the Enabling Employment Credit is mainly for folks who have more permanent disabilities in terms of physical, intellectual, sensory impairments and also developmental needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: With regard to the newspaper article in terms of the higher unemployment, we are also working together with tripartite partners to make sure that these arrangements are made available to raise awareness among employers on how they can do better inclusive hiring, and also working, for example, with the National Kidney Foundation's chief executive officer Yen Tan, in terms of understanding the potential employers' needs as well.
